items.name: idempotency
items.title: withIdempotency
items.description: Idempotency-Key middleware for write routes. Caches the response by (method, path, key) in Upstash Redis for 24h so retries / double-clicks return the original result without re-executing the handler.

items.name: webhook-verifier
items.title: verifyHmacSignature + requireHmacSignature
items.description: Generic HMAC signature verifier for inbound webhooks (Resend, Slack, custom partners). Configurable algorithm + encoding, auto-strips signature prefix, constant-time comparison via timingSafeEqual.

items.name: health-endpoints
items.title: healthz + readyz
items.description: Liveness (/api/healthz, always 200) and readiness (/api/readyz, 200 only when DB + Redis are reachable) handlers. Drop into app/api/healthz/route.ts and app/api/readyz/route.ts.
